_comment_confidence: QuantAgent confidence must exceed this threshold. Lowered from 0.65 to 0.55 pre-calibration — will tighten at V2.1 with 30+ closed trades.
_comment_sl: Default SL = entry ± (ATR_14 × 1.5). StrategyAgent may narrow but not widen.
_comment_tp: Minimum reward-to-risk ratio of 2:1 for a setup to be included in playbook.
_comment_conviction: Confidence >= 0.80 → high conviction (2% risk). >= 0.55 → standard (1% risk). < 0.55 → SKIP. Pre-calibration thresholds — tighten at V2.1.
